meta.description: Registry for quantifier-related failure modes in the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: unbounded_universal_domain
failure_modes.description: The domain of a universal quantifier is non-finite or lacks explicit formal boundaries.

failure_modes.name: empty_domain
failure_modes.description: The quantified domain is empty, rendering the statement vacuously true or formally undefined.

failure_modes.name: empty_witness_set
failure_modes.description: An existential quantifier fails to find a valid witness satisfying the declared conditions.

failure_modes.name: ambiguous_witness
failure_modes.description: Multiple candidates satisfy the existential condition without a selection or pruning rule.

failure_modes.name: scope_drift
failure_modes.description: The quantifier scope changes inconsistently during iteration or recursive composition.

failure_modes.name: boundary_case_undefined
failure_modes.description: Quantification fails to explicitly account for edge cases such as null states or window boundaries.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_relation_unbound
failure_modes.description: Quantification relies on an equivalence relation that lacks formal property verification.

failure_modes.name: candidate_set_unresolved
failure_modes.description: The set of candidates for quantification is not formally resolved or registered.

failure_modes.name: quantifier_collapse_under_projection
failure_modes.description: Forward projection results in the loss of necessary distinctions within the quantified domain.
